name: Living with Temptation 2: Foreign Affairs
source:
The game is a sequel to "[url=http://lopgold.com/index_lwt.php]Living with Temptation[/url]", which is not a visual novel.

Your son Charlie had his first birthday a couple of months ago, and is happy and healthy and growing fast. His former babysitter Lisa stayed in touch while she attended University over the winter and has come back to work for you and your wife Tracy again this summer.

You are happy to take Charlie out of daycare now that Lisa is back. Your job has been going great, Tracy got a promotion at work, and the money is rolling in.

Suddenly you get an invitation from your cousin to come and visit him in France at his summer home in the foothills of the Alps. It’s a nice invitation, but you are not completely thrilled because your cousin Richard has always been a bit of a competitive asshole.

But Tracy would love a trip to the French countryside, and Lisa could come on the trip as well to help with Charlie. You decide to take the trip and find yourself on a plane to France.

[Edited from [url=http://lopgold.com/index_lwt2.php]Official site[/url]]
translation:
该游戏是“[url=http://lopgold.com/index_lwt.php]生活与诱惑[/url]”的续集，这不是视觉小说。

你的儿子查理几个月前度过了他的第一个生日，他很快乐、健康并且成长得很快。他的前保姆丽莎在冬天上大学期间一直与我们保持联系，今年夏天又回来为你和你的妻子特雷西工作。

丽莎回来了，你很高兴带查理离开日托中心。你的工作进展顺利，特雷西升职了，钱也滚滚而来。

突然，你收到表弟的邀请，前往法国阿尔卑斯山脚下的避暑别墅探望他。这是一个很好的邀请，但你并不完全兴奋，因为你的表弟理查德一直是一个有点好胜的混蛋。

但特蕾西很喜欢去法国乡村旅行，丽莎也可以参加这次旅行，帮助查理。你决定踏上旅程，却发现自己登上了飞往法国的飞机。

[编辑自[url=http://lopgold.com/index_lwt2.php]官方网站[/url]]
